map.选择桩步类型，计算站桩姿势的重心位置与前脚承重比例，结合站桩时间累积给出耐力评分: Choose a stance type to compute the center-of-gravity position and front-foot weight share of the posture, and combine it with accumulated stance time for an endurance score, quantifying stance training.
map.武术桩步训练：选择马步/弓步/虚步/仆步等桩型与步距、身高、前脚承重比、下蹲深度: Martial arts stance training: choose a stance such as horse stance, bow stance, empty stance, or crouching stance together with step width, height, front-foot weight share, squat depth, and duration, and compute the center-of-gravity height, offset, and stability/endurance scores.
map.重心平衡教学：通过调整前脚承重比使其接近该桩型标准承重（如马步50%、弓步65%: Center-of-gravity balance teaching: adjust the front-foot weight share toward the standard for that stance (50% for horse stance, 65% for bow stance) to reduce the offset and raise the stability index.
map.耐力量化：结合下蹲深度与持续时间量化桩功负荷，辅助制定训练计划与强度渐进。: Endurance quantification: combines squat depth and duration to quantify stance training load, helping plan training and progress intensity.

map.重心偏移和稳定性怎么算？: How Are the Center Offset and Stability Computed?
map.重心偏移=(前脚承重%-50%)×步距，正为前偏、负为后偏；稳定性=100-|实: Center-of-gravity offset = (front foot weight % − 50%) × step width, positive meaning forward and negative backward; stability = 100 − |actual weight − standard weight| × 1.5, so the closer to the standard weight the higher it is. Standard front-foot shares are about 50% for horse stance, 65% for bow stance, and 25% for empty stance.
map.耐力=50+min(40,时长×2)-强度×时长×2。下蹲越深、桩型强度越大、持: Endurance = 50 + min(40, duration × 2) − intensity × duration × 2. The deeper the squat, the more intense the stance, and the longer it is held, the higher the load; the formula is an approximate quantification of training load for comparing sessions rather than an absolute standard.
